## Checklist

- [ ] I exported the preset from the shell (Presets page → Export) and did not edit the JSON by hand
- [ ] The folder is `presets/<name>/` and contains `<name>.json`, `meta.json` and the images
- [ ] I only added or changed files inside `presets/`
- [ ] The images are mine or free to redistribute
- [ ] No personal or NSFW content in the previews or wallpapers
